source.stem: Which structures in plants and in humans normally carry amino acids?

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Carbohydrates can replace all protein in an adolescent's diet if fats, vitamins, minerals and regular exercise are included.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: An adolescent who eats a nutritious diet does not need exercise or physical games.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Once an adolescent reaches adult height, a nutritious diet and regular exercise are no longer needed.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Choose sweets and soft drinks rather than varied nutritious meals because they taste better, and keep exercising regularly.

intelligence.enrichment: Because adolescence is a period of growth and development marked by several body changes, adolescents need a nutritious diet with proteins, carbohydrates, adequate fats, vitamins, and minerals, along with regular exercise and physical activities. adolescent growth and development -> greater need for nutrition and activity -> healthy body and better physical functioning The learner applies the need for a nutritious adolescent diet containing several nutrient groups along with regular exercise and physical activity. A growing adolescent only needs a favorite filling food; exercise or nutrient variety is optional.
